# langsmith_prompts (Data Source)

Lists LangSmith prompts (repos), with optional filters. All pages are fetched.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "langsmith_prompts" "all" {}

data "langsmith_prompts" "active_private" {
  is_public   = false
  is_archived = "false"
}

output "prompt_handles" {
  value = [for p in data.langsmith_prompts.all.prompts : p.repo_handle]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `is_archived` (String) Filter by archive status. Valid values: `true`, `false`, `allow` (include both).
- `is_public` (Boolean) Filter by public visibility.
- `query` (String) Free-text search over prompt repos.
- `tags` (List of String) Filter to prompts carrying all the given tags.
- `workspace_id` (String) If set, overrides the provider-level `workspace_id` for all API calls made by this data source.

### Read-Only

- `prompts` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--prompts))
